scripts.pods: cd ios && LANG=en_US.UTF-8 LC_ALL=en_US.UTF-8 pod install
scripts.build:local:android: yarn prebuild:android && cd android && JAVA_HOME="$(/usr/libexec/java_home -v 17)" ./gradlew :app:assembleRelease -x lint -x lintVitalAnalyzeRelease -x lintVitalRelease && echo "APK: $(pwd)/app/build/outputs/apk/release/app-release.apk"
scripts.build:local:ios: yarn prebuild:ios && cd ios && xcodebuild -workspace AppiumTestEnvironment.xcworkspace -scheme AppiumTestEnvironment -configuration Release -sdk iphonesimulator -destination 'generic/platform=iOS Simulator' -derivedDataPath ./build CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build && echo "APP: $(pwd)/build/Build/Products/Release-iphonesimulator/AppiumTestEnvironment.app"
